gazette_location.description_raw_en: A road as shown coloured pink on Drawing No. CM 251 commencing at Victoria Park Road north-east of Victoria Park running eastwards for about 250 metres then northwards for about 300 metres joined by slip roads to and from Hing Fat Street; it then turns to run north-eastwards for 750 metres then eastwards for 200 metres joined by slip roads to and from Tong Shui Road; after a further 700 metres it is joined by a slip road onto Java Road and from King's Road; it continues easterly for 450 metres joined by slip roads branching northwards from Java Road; then easterly for 1 100 metres joined by slip roads to and from Taikoo Shing; then easterly for about 350 metres gradually turning southwards for 200 metres joined by slip roads to and from the Kornhill Development; continuing southwards for about 150 metres then south-eastwards for about 900 metres over Sai Wan Ho Reclamation joined by slip roads to and from Shau Kei Wan Interchange; then eastwards for about 250 metres turning north-eastwards then eastwards around A Kung Ngam for about 600 metres to the Lyemun Barrack boundary; then south-eastwards for about 1 100 metres then southwards for 350 metres joined by slip roads to and from Wing Tai Interchange; continuing southwards for 750 metres to join Chai Wan Road.
gazette_location.description_raw_zh: 此街道位於CM 251號圖則上粉紅色所示位置，由維多利亞公園東北之一處維園道起，向東伸展約二百五十米，再向北伸展約三百米，與通往及來自興發街之支路連接。其後轉向東北伸展七百五十米，再轉向東，伸展二百米，與通往及來自糖水道之支路連接，再繼續伸展七百米，與通往渣華道及來自英皇道之支路連接，再大致向東繼續伸展四百五十米，與從渣華道北面伸出之支路連接。其後再向東伸展一千一百米，與通往及來自太古城之支路連接。其後繼續向東伸展約三百五十米，逐漸轉南伸展二百米，與通往及來自康山發展區之支路連接，繼續向南伸展約一百五十米，然後轉向東南伸展約九百米，跨越西灣河新填地，然後與通往及來自筲箕灣交匯處之支路連接。其後繼續向東伸展約二百五十米，轉向東北，再轉東彎過阿公岩區伸展約六百米，抵達鯉魚門軍營邊界。其後向東南伸展約一千一百米，再轉向南伸展三百五十米，與通往及來自永泰交匯處之支路連接。其後繼續向南伸展七百五十米，與柴灣道連接。

gazette_location.description_raw_en: An extension of the existing Wing Tai Road as shown coloured yellow on Drawing No. CM 251 commencing from the existing Wing Tai Road running north-westwards for 350 metres then turning northwards for 100 metres to join the Island Eastern Corridor.
gazette_location.description_raw_zh: 現時之永泰道須延長。其位置於CM 251號圖則上以黃色標明，伸延部份由現時之永泰道起，向西北伸展三百五十米，再轉向北伸展一百米，與東區走廊連接。
